pages.text: $(primary)XC-443$(), now that you have unlocked robust logistic capabilities you can freely automate and improve on previous designs.$(br2)These added capabilities mean that we also will expect more from you.$(br2)Future tasks will require a lot more materials, and a robust automation of ingredients from the earlier simulations.

Before rushing of to complete the next shiny task, we think you should have the following things up and running:$(br2)$(li)Basic AE2 Network$(li)$(l:sim_2/__late_dimension_tips#quarry)Ore Quarry$()$()$(li)$(l:sim_3/helpful_stuff#conduits)Ender IO conduits$()$()$(li)Automated Ore Smelting$()$(li)Plate, Gear & Alloy autocrafting$()$(li)$(l:sim_2/__late_dimension_tips#starmetal)Starmetal automation$()$()$(li)Lubricant Automation$()$(li)Sanguine Metal Autocrafting$()$(li)Dried Brick Automation$()$(li)Brittle Plastic Automation$()$(li)Plastic Automation$()

pages.title: Guidance
pages.text: The following pages will go into more depth about some of these requirements.$(br2)(We say requirements, but they are optional. You're free to chose your own pains.)

pages.title: Automated Ore Smelting
pages.text: We recommend using $(item)Induction Smelters$() to process $(item)Ores$() into $(item)Ingots$().$(br2)This method is preferred by our people since it produces a lot of $(item)Rich Slag$().$(br2)To smelt $(item)Ores$() this way, you will also need a large amount of $(item)Sand$(), automate this too.

pages.title: Sanguine Autocrafting
pages.text: A large amount of blood can be produced by setting up an automation that places $(item)Blessed Blood Resin Logs$() on the ground, and having a few $(item)Tree Fluid Extractors$() tapping the logs for blood.$(br2)$(item)Bloody Mud$() has an alternate recipe in the $(item)Fluid Transposer$().

pages.title: Lubricant Automation
pages.text: You should already have some sort of automation for this.$(br2)Make sure the biproducts are handled so the machines don't clog up.

pages.title: Drying Automation
pages.text: Both $(item)Brittle Plastic$() and $(item)Dried brick$() are produced through drying. The $(item)Drying Racks$() you made in the first simulation is fully capable of being automated since they respond to cable IO.$(br2)If you want to ramp up production early, the $(item)Mass Drying Chamber$() may be worth to invest into.

As with other multiblocks, it can be found in $(l:portal_hub/4_schematica)Schematica$().$(br2)Both options are viable, but the $(item)Mass Drying Chamber$() is of course more efficient.$(br2)$(l:sim_3/__late_dimension_tips)Selectively quarrying for clay$() may be a good option to get dried brick automation going.

pages.title: Sifting Automation
pages.text: It's also advisable to fully automate the $(l:sim_3/1_minerals)sifting$() of $(item)Red Canyon Dust$().$(br2)Further down the line you won't even have to pulverize the red rock into $(item)Red Canyon Dust$(), since it can be transmuted in the $(l:sim_2/8_cosmic_gazing)Altar of Cosmic Transmutation$().$(br2)Items can be inserted into the auto sifter with cabling.
